about: The plans the tour cannot reach: the leaf role, the deeper geohash levels, and every S2 plan. Same ground as the Mars tour steps, so a difference here is a difference in the systems and not in the ground.
source: issue #5 §5.4 — the guarantees the tour leaves unexercised

steps.note: One level below anything the tour holds: 31 neighbours at distance 2, 31 at distance 1, the scope, and 32 children.
The floor of the geohash telescope (depth 3). A cell at maxLevel emits as a `leaf` and its children are never asked for — the one role the tour never reaches.
The same plan with the subdivision put away: the plan is identical and only the style tokens move, which is the seam boundary this pair pins.
S2 at the root: the six faces, in face order, each ring a tessellated geodesic loop.
The north-polar face held: five neighbouring faces, the scope, four children — and the pole field carried on the cells that circle it.
The S2 floor: port level 11 is maxLevel, so 47a1cb emits as a `leaf` after ten generations of neighbours — the deepest plan either system produces, and the positional order of ten ancestor rings.
